in_marathi.name: Rishikshudra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seeker of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishikshudra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rishikshudra is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'Rishi' (Seer, Sage) and 'Kshudra' (Seeker, Learner). This name is given to a boy who is believed to be a seeker of knowledge and wisdom, just like the ancient Rishis (Sages) who imparted knowledge to the world.
